run_gtest_help_test_with_flag: run the gtest_help_test_ binary with a given command-line flag and return exit code and output
test_help_flag_behavior: test that passing a help flag prints the help message and skips test execution
test_non_help_flag_behavior: test that passing a non-help flag runs tests and does not print the help message
test_help_with_various_flags: test help output with full flag, short flag, question mark, and Windows-style question flag
test_help_with_incorrect_flag_style: test help output when incorrect flag variants like single dash or forward slash are used
